outcome: Antioxidant defense system genes, proteins, and enzymes
cohort: The study included placentae from women with a prepregnancy BMI < 25 kg/m2 (control; n=15) and women with metabolically healthy obesity (prepregnancy BMI > 30 kg/m2 with no cardiometabolic diseases; n=15).
finding: Uncomplicated metabolically healthy obese pregnancies exhibited clear placentomegaly without histopathological changes and distinct altered placental metabolomic profiles, particularly in cysteine, methionine, and vitamin B6 metabolism pathways.
